title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - CheckSum
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/CheckSum. Detail on how to calculate or verify a checksum.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CheckSum'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

checkSumCalculation.description: Property. Algorithm used to create the checksum. Controlled-vocabulary value (ChecksumAlgorithm), enumeration not resolved in this pass.
